pages.text: $(item)Charoite$() is a powerful magical alloy found naturally in the Everbright and Everdawn. Fortunately, it's also craftable.$(br2)Charoite is the only material capable of containing the power of a Command Block. It can also create an $(item)Enchanting Table$(), and if you stockpile enough, you could make armor that enhances your melee strikes!

Between Charoite and other useful tools, you probably don't have enough tainted dust to do everything you want. That's fine! It can be combined with redstone dust to $(thing)duplicate$() it.$(br2)If you ever run out, return to where you fought the Withered Symbiont. Tainted flesh blocks can be used in a $(item)stonecutter$() to get more dust. If even that fails, you can try to fight another Withered Symbiont to get more.
